### Closure (the check that stands in for an oracle)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Balanced cases assembled | 81 (54 flight, 27 ground) |
| Flight cases: inertia resultant ÷ (−n<sub>z</sub>·W) | 1.0000 to 1.0000 (LIMIT: no factor applied) |
| Largest closure relief Δn on a flight case | -0.190 (UNSYMMETRICAL, fwd gross) |
| LRA deck subcases whose six resultants close to zero | 81 of 81 |

Δn is the rigid-body load-factor increment the closure applied: how much of the balance was assumed rather than computed. The deck check re-reads the written `FORCE`/`MOMENT` cards (`sloads.export.equilibrium`).
